name: velo-soul-demo
description: VELO SOUL: three bicycle personalities, Korean voice companionship and journey cards

scripts.test: node --test server.test.mjs final.test.mjs language.test.mjs audio.test.mjs chat.test.mjs places.test.mjs vision.test.mjs connected.test.mjs hands-free.test.mjs browser-api.test.mjs microphone.test.mjs speech.test.mjs streaming.test.mjs weather.test.mjs asr-realtime.test.mjs mouth.test.mjs audio-session.test.mjs audio-devices.test.mjs native-speech.test.mjs speech-cache.test.mjs photo-capture.test.mjs journey-store.test.mjs qr-cache.test.mjs bike-memory.test.mjs korea-map.test.mjs gps-ui.test.mjs character-motion.test.mjs character-2d.test.mjs character-toon.test.mjs native-app.test.mjs media-recovery.test.mjs
scripts.build: esbuild public/final.js --bundle --minify --charset=utf8 --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=public/app.bundle.js && esbuild public/styles.entry.css --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=public/app.css && esbuild public/character-toon.mjs --bundle --minify --charset=utf8 --format=esm --target=es2020 --outfile=public/character-toon.bundle.mjs && node build-assets.mjs
scripts.native:prepare: npm run build && node build-native.mjs && cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run native:prepare && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
